Parties have resolved the dispute.
Divorce proceedings are  pending before the Family Court at Bandra.
Consent Terms are filed in  the said proceedings.
Applicant No.1 and Respondent No.1 have agreed  to dissolve their marriage by mutual consent.
5. As per the consent terms, the Respondent No.1 has agreed  for quashing the impugned charge-sheet.
6. Respondent No.1 is present in Court.
She has filed an  Affidavit.

In paragraph 7 of the Affidavit, it is stated that in consent  terms dated 17th October 2023, the Applicant No.1 had agreed to return  the articles belonging to Respondent No.1 at the time of quashing the  proceedings.

Respondent No.1 has no objection for quashing the FIR  registered at her instance vide Crime No. 768 of 2022 which is the  subject matter of C.C. No. PW/256/2023 pending before the learned  Metropolitan Magistrate, 17th Court, Borivali, Mumbai.
4. Considering the fact that the dispute was on account of  matrimonial discord and the parties have resolved the dispute
, the  proceedings can be quashed.
ORDER (i) Criminal Application No. 1420 of 2023 is allowed.

(ii) Proceedings in CC No. PW/256/2023 pending before the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 17th Court, Borivali, Mumbai are quashed and set aside.
( N.R. BORKAR, J. ) ( PRAKASH D. NAIK, J. )
